title: Apple Opens Siri AI Preview to All Software Developers for Expanded App Integration
summary:
Third party software creators can now integrate their application's features and data directly into Apple's AI-driven voice assistant. The latest update allows the system to pull content and trigger actions from any app using a mechanism called App Intents, replacing the previous model that limited Siri to interactions within specific domains.

The expanded capabilities are provided through a new developer preview. In version 27.3 of the software, the assistant is able to utilize any implemented app intent to perform tasks across various compatible third party applications.
